independent_probes.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { spawn } from "node:child_process"; import { INITIAL_COUNT, transition } from "./src/counter.mjs"; const actions=["increment","decrement","reset"]; let sequences=0, steps=0; function walk(count, expected, depth) { if (!depth) { sequences++; return; } for (const action of actions) { const next=transition(count, action); const oracle=action==="increment"?expected+1:action==="reset"?0:expected===0?0:expected-1; assert.equal(next,oracle); assert.ok(next>=0); steps++; walk(next,oracle,depth-1); } } walk(INITIAL_COUNT,0,8); const server=spawn(process.execPath,["scripts/serve.mjs","--host","127.0.0.1","--port","4174"],{stdio:["ignore","pipe","pipe"]}); const failures=[]; server.stderr.on("data",d=>failures.push(String(d))); try { await Promise.race([new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{server.stdout.once("data",resolve);server.once("error",reject);server.once("exit",code=>reject(new Error("server exit "+code)));}),new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error("start timeout")),5000).unref())]); const results=[]; for (const [method,path,status] of [["GET","/",200],["GET","/src/app.mjs",200],["GET","/src/counter.mjs",200],["HEAD","/",200],["GET","/package.json",404],["GET","/.git/config",404],["GET","/%2e%2e/package.json",404],["POST","/",405]]) { const response=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:4174"+path,{method,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(3000)}); assert.equal(response.status,status); if(method==="HEAD")assert.equal(await response.text(),""); if(method==="POST")assert.equal(response.headers.get("allow"),"GET, HEAD"); if(path==="/src/app.mjs")assert.match(response.headers.get("content-type"),/javascript/); results.push({method,path,status:response.status}); } assert.deepEqual(failures,[]); console.log(JSON.stringify({target_commit:"cd8a21cf3e5cd919e78aad0a1516d2a517649d38",probe:"independent-rule-and-static-server-boundaries",status:"passed",sequences,steps,http_checks:results},null,2)); } finally { server.kill("SIGTERM"); }'
